name: Periodic schedule compiler
semantic_facts: one PeriodicSchedule per exact resolved periodic contract (trigger 23 / damage 3,89 / leech 53 / heal 8,20 / energize 24,21 / mana leech 64); duplicate effect across families rejects (periodic.rs:694-760)
authored period = raw EffectAuraPeriod, must be positive i32 (periodic.rs:997-1002)
initial policy must agree with raw attribute 169 TickOnApplication in both directions (periodic.rs:1449-1474)
SpellCastSpeed cadence iff raw attribute 173 present AND RestartCadence; 173 with PreserveCadence rejects (periodic.rs:1389-1404)
WholeEffectivePeriods alignment admitted only for exact Venom 391428 effect 1 with 173+273+278 (haste_affected_duration.rs:52-72)
terminal policy: damage/heal ProportionalNaturalExpiryPartial, trigger/energize/leech/mana-leech None (periodic.rs:436-448)

reapplication/cadence pairing: CappedCarryover, IndependentStackDeadlines, PreserveExistingLifetime forbid RestartCadence; damage/heal additionally forbid RestartLifetime+PreserveCadence; trigger/energize do not (periodic.rs:1588-1678)
AsynchronousStackingBuff (and HasteAffectsDuration/MeleeHaste/RollingPeriodic) owners reject for every periodic family (periodic.rs:87-121)

name: PeriodicAuthority cadence cells and deadline queue
semantic_facts: cell = {captured target, cadence_anchor, aura_expires_at, period_millis, initial_pending, active}; one deadline per schedule slot keyed (at, slot)
pending tick: initial at anchor; else full tick at anchor+period if <= aura_expires_at; else terminal partial at aura_expires_at if proportional policy and expiry > anchor (periodic.rs:507-549)
fire advances cadence before child execution except SpellCastSpeed full ticks, which re-arm after the child using occurrence-current haste (periodic.rs:313-357, 396-440)

application quote: PreserveCadence on an active cell keeps anchor/period/initial and only retargets + moves expiry; otherwise anchor=now, period=effective_period(now haste), initial_pending = previous || (fresh Applied && OnFreshApplication) (periodic.rs:716-769)
removal (quote transition Removed) deactivates every schedule of that aura slot; other non-Apply mutations do not touch cells (periodic.rs:658-688)
cancel_aura deactivates cells and cancels deadlines; reset clears cells and queue (periodic.rs:471-481)

name: Periodic tick execution (CombatState)
semantic_facts: a tick first checks the AURA RECIPIENT's liveness; a dead recipient cancels the aura's schedules silently and the aura itself remains active (periodic_execution.rs:449-457)
tick child runs through execute_immediate_driver with source=aura source, target=captured target index, time=tick.at
amount context = live aura stacks (point-stacking policy), elapsed/period fraction; amount formula evaluated fresh at occurrence (periodic_health.rs:35-38)
health-context ticks cancel the schedule after a lethal occurrence (periodic_execution.rs:497-504)
re-arm uses the aura source's haste after the child executed (periodic_execution.rs:379-401)

name: Immediate driver edges and execution
semantic_facts: driver child binding by exact ProgramNodeId binary search; per-aura driver range by spell id partition (driver.rs:7-28)
immediate drivers bypass cast admission; only preflight_execution_health gates caster/target life when the child program requires health (execution/health.rs:190-211)
failure of the child quote emits ExecutionFizzled and mutates nothing (driver_execution.rs:696-706)

name: Natural-expiry driver compiler and execution
semantic_facts: raw subtype 495 on an aura-owning effect; child must equal EffectTriggerSpell; misc0 != 0 => OriginalAuraSource else AuraRecipient; target always aura recipient (expiry.rs:72-154)
owner attributes IgnoreTimeRate/HasteAffectsDuration/AsynchronousStackingBuff reject (expiry.rs:14-18)
runs only from ordinary natural AuraExpiry after the aura commit + periodic cancel + natural thresholds; explicit removal and dispel never run it (state.rs:1368-1397)
no liveness gate: runs even when the aura recipient already died (expiry_execution.rs:9-40)

name: Aura lifetime policy
semantic_facts: IndependentStackDeadlines iff max_stacks > 1 and aura spell owns AsynchronousStackingBuff; otherwise SingleDeadline (aura_lifetime.rs:11-35)
periodic/expiry subsystems require a finite aura (aura_lifetime.rs:60-79)

name: Aura mutation input
semantic_facts: plain carrier of (recipient, effect, aura, count, Apply(reapplication)|AddStacks|RemoveStacks|Remove); no validation of its own

name: Aura reapplication policy compiler
semantic_facts: CappedCarryover iff resolved CappedCarryover AND aura spell owns raw 436 (both directions) (aura_reapplication.rs:436-466)
IndependentStackDeadlines iff aura lifetime policy says so and base RestartLifetime
PreserveExistingLifetime iff AuraUnique-preserving source or application spell owns AuraDoesNotRefresh
AuraUnique conflicts with every other preservation policy

name: Aura state apply / carryover / expiry projection
semantic_facts: active refresh with CappedCarryover: expiry = max(existing, now + d + min(remaining, floor(3d/10))) (aura_state.rs:1153-1200)
PreserveExistingLifetime on active aura changes only stacks (aura_state.rs:747-766)
a quote at exactly expires_at is still admitted (ExpiryPending only when expires_at < now) (aura_state.rs:1118-1127)
no liveness check on the recipient anywhere in apply quoting

name: Child activation compiler
semantic_facts: TRIGGER_MISSILE -> inline Activate; TRIGGER_SPELL -> deferred ScheduleActivation; child must equal EffectTriggerSpell
deferred launch requires misc0 (delay) == 0 and misc1 == 0
child target derived from implicit targets (none/any/enemy/ally -> inherited primary, caster -> caster) and must equal the resolved target

name: Passive-flow flat modifier compiler
semantic_facts: per-effect flat units/s aura modifier; one-stack single-deadline carriers only (passive_flow_flat/validation.rs max_stacks==1); affects_mutation false for AddStacks (safe because max_stacks==1)

name: Passive-flow percentage modifier compiler
semantic_facts: per-effect percentage factor on base passive flow; one-stack single-deadline carriers only

name: Passive-flow suppression compiler
semantic_facts: resource-mask suppression cohorts per aura; suppression zeroes effective passive flow before percentage/flat (passive_resource_flow.rs PassiveFlowPolicyView::evaluate)

name: Resource threshold drivers (raw 396)
semantic_facts: gain fires iff before < T && after >= T; loss iff before > T && after <= T (resource_threshold.rs:860-870) — identical to Trinity Unit.cpp:10144-10153
startup fires on current >= T (gain) / <= T (loss) (resource_threshold.rs:852-858)
passive-flow crossing deadline = ms binary search over the projection for the nearest threshold beyond current in the flow direction (resource_threshold/passive_flow.rs:436-546)

name: Resource gain / periodic energize operations
semantic_facts: Fixed / PercentOfMaximum gains validated against effect kind contract; periodic energize payload prevalidated and gated on living recipient when payload requires it (resource_gain.rs:57-91)

name: Resource damage: power burn / power drain
semantic_facts: power burn admitted only for exact spell 46266 effect 1 carrier; power drain exact neutral amount facts; both dispatch through resource_damage::compile_step

name: Maximum resource modifier compiler
semantic_facts: per-aura max-resource deltas grouped into cohorts; passive percentage factors > 1.0; reachable delta bounds precomputed for clamp policy

name: Target aura condition
semantic_facts: marker aura + (mechanic|state) identity byte; plain data carrier consumed by modifier compilers

name: Dispel and mechanic dispel
semantic_facts: magic dispel admits only BLIND_FAITH / MAGE_ARMOR single-stack single-deadline self auras with NO periodic schedules (dispel.rs:238-247)
mechanic dispel applicand must be single-stack, self-only, with no periodic fanout (dispel_mechanic.rs:387-395)
dispel removes the whole aura via quote_remove_from; RNG ordinal via uniform_index on a cloned stream in quote (execution/planning/dispel.rs:94-116)

name: Resource program composition
semantic_facts: composes passive flow flat/percentage/suppression, maximum-resource, threshold plans into one optional resource root

name: Independent stack lifetime authority
semantic_facts: bounded cohort pool per aura; expiry earliest (deadline, sequence) first; overflow displaces earliest cohorts
last stack expiry cancels periodic and emits AuraExpired; never runs expiry drivers (combination rejected at compile by raw AsynchronousStackingBuff on expiry/periodic owners)

name: Deadline queue
semantic_facts: indexed min-heap keyed (at, sequence) with per-slot position; upsert/cancel by slot give at most one live deadline per slot

name: Same-time transition ordering
semantic_facts: (at, rank, seq): threshold startup 0, passive-flow threshold 1, cast 2 (actor), fixed impact 3, white 4, periodic 5 (slot), aura & independent expiry 6 (sequence)

name: Passive resource flow runtime
semantic_facts: projection = clamp(basis_balance + rate/1000 * (at - basis_at)) from an immutable basis; settle commits projection without moving basis; rebase moves basis to current
every transition settles all pools at its time before executing (state.rs advance paths)

name: Periodic quote capacity / periodic dispatch
semantic_facts: program has periodic quotes iff some AuraMutation (not AddStacks) targets an aura with schedules; Dispel and DispelMechanic removals count 0 (planning.rs:565-595)
PERIODIC=false quote path skips periodic projection entirely (aura_lifecycle.rs:278-280)
